page.layout: One page of text, one column, with arithmetic displays set within it. Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature "A" at foot centre. No margin notes.

main_text.p: subtrahi nequit, prepono, & pergo dicens: 5 à 14 remanent 9, quae supra scribo, 4 à 5 remanet unum, quod sequenti notae praepono, & pergo dicens, 5 à 14 remanent 9, quae supra scribo. Subductio sic est:
Mutuavi tibi 3634, ter millenos sexcen-tos triginta quatuor aureos: Et tu solvisti 2600, bis millenos sexcentos. Quaeritur quot mihi solvere debeas?
Et dico 2 à 3 remanet 1, quod supra scribo: 6 à 6, remanet o, quam supra scribo: o à 3 remanent 3, quae supra noto: o à 4 remanent 4, quae supra scribo. Subductio sic est:
Mercatoris famulus accepit primū Thaleros 1029: Deinde 2101. Iterum 7068.
Expofuit verò prima vice 917: secunda 809: Tertia 8048.

page.notes: Display lines of the subtraction and addition examples are set as printed, with the small dot marks between digits in the subtraction lines (7 ·4, 5 ·4) and the superscript borrow marks above the first digits, which are not reproduced exactly. Long s in "Expofuit" is read as a long s, so the word is given as "Exposuit". The tilde over the u of "primũ" is rendered as ū. The mark above "Quaeritur" is a decorative flourish and is not transcribed.
